'''Pote Snitkin''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Skrilling]] [[arms dealer]] and [[pilot]] who worked for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. In [[4 ABY]], he viewed a perfomance of [[Jedi Rocks]] by the [[Max Rebo Band]] at [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] shortly before [[pilot]]ing one of Jabba's [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]]s to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]].

Jabba planned to feed a group of prisoners to the [[sarlacc]] that lived in the pit, but the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] broke free and managed to board Snitkin's skiff. Skywalker quickly defeated all of the guards on board the skiff and Snitkin himself before moving onto Jabba's [[sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]''. Snitkin then fell into the sarlacc and was eaten.

==Biography==
Pote Snitkin was a [[Gender|male]] [[Skrilling]] [[pilot]] and contraband [[arms dealer]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> and [[smuggler]]<ref name="HothEncyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}}</ref> who served in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> He was amongst the members of Jabba's entourage present alongside their master in his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In the palace's throne room, Snitkin stood with other court members and watched a performance<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> of [[Jedi Rocks]] by the [[Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="AEYNTK" />

[[File:Snitkinskiff.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Pote Snitkin piloted one of Jabba's skiffs.]]
Due to his experience as a pilot, Snitkin was later put in charge of one<ref name="HothEncyclopedia" /> of two [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]]s that accompanied Jabba's [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]'' to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] in the [[Dune Sea]], where the crime lord planned to feed a group of prisoners to the [[sarlacc]] that inhabited the pit. Snitkin's skiff only carried guards, with the prisoners being transported on the other skiff; however, during the attempted [[Death|execution]], the [[Jedi]] prisoner [[Luke Skywalker]] attacked and defeated the guards on the prisoner transport skiff.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Snitkin then manoeuvred the second skiff so the guards on board could shoot at Skywalker and the other prisoners, but the Jedi leapt aboard the Skrilling's skiff and made short work of the guards it carried. Snitkin was one of the last on board the skiff to be defeated, and ended up lying on the floor of the skiff as Skywalker leapt from the vehicle onto the ''Khetanna''.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The pilot was then thrown overboard into the pit beneath the skiff,<ref name="Geektionary" /> where the Skrilling was devoured by the sarlacc.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> Skywalker and his companions ultimately killed Jabba and destroyed his sail barge before escaping.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Pote Snitkin was a sturdy, [[Color|green]]-skinned Skrilling.<ref name="Geektionary" />

==Equipment==
Snitkin wore a light brown [[Clothing|shawl]] over an orange shirt with a dark brown shirt underneath. He also wore light brown pants and brown [[Clothing|shoes]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Pote_Snitkin_concept_art.png|thumb|right|Concept art of Snitkin by Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]
Pote Snitkin first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character was known as Snit Plotkin on set,<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|potesnitkin|Snitkin, Pote}}</ref> but the name Pote Snitkin was used on the official creature list during production.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref>

The name was first used in a published source in the current canon in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'',<ref name="AEYNTK" /> although it was previously first published in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', which was written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and released in [[1994]].<ref name="Guide2nd">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> A costume sketch of Snitkin was produced by costume designer [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] for ''Return of the Jedi'' based on a design by concept artist [[Ken Ralston]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
